styleguide.heroLede: One identity told at two hours of the day. Solar is the sunlit almanac on the cartographer’s table; Astral is the same chart under the night sky. Gold is the through-line — heliograph ink by day, constellation lines by night — and the text stays a warm ivory-cream in both. Everything below is driven by the same CSS custom-property layer that apps/web ships.
styleguide.paletteNote: Slices request a role, never a raw colour. Showing the active theme.
